scenario: After an sklearn upgrade, a production RMSE helper raises TypeError because the squared keyword is no longer accepted. A version-bound handoff says the current public API exposes a dedicated RMSE function.
instruction: Choose one adoption candidate. The evaluator will implement it and run numerical compatibility tests in the installed environment.

candidates.description: Keep squared=False and catch failures at the caller.
Adopt the dedicated current RMSE API named in the versioned handoff.
Return zero if the metric call fails.
